turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: Thanks for joining, Priya. Agenda for today: understand your current triage workflow, see if a pilot makes sense, and if so pick a dated next step. Does that work?

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: Yes. We have forty support agents and exception tickets are eating overtime.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: Walk me through what happens when an exception ticket lands.

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: It sits in a shared inbox until someone grabs it. Peak weeks we run a day behind, and CSAT tanks.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: What does that backlog cost you in overtime or churn?

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: Overtime alone is about twelve thousand a month in Q4. Churn is harder to pin down.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: Who else needs to weigh in if we proposed a sixty day pilot under fifty k?

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: I can greenlight under fifty k. My VP, Marcus, wants a security review before anything goes live. Budget is tight this half.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: That's fair. When you say tight, is it total dollars or how spend is split? Teams usually fund us from the overtime line if triage time drops by half.

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: Funding from overtime could work if the pilot actually halves triage. We also looked at Zendesk AI since we already pay for Zendesk.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: Makes sense to compare. Does funding from overtime address the budget concern for now?

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: For now yes. Marcus will still want the security packet.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: Then let's get him that. Can we book thirty minutes Friday at 10am with you and Marcus to review a pilot plan and the security overview?

turns.speaker: Priya (Prospect)
turns.text: Friday at 10am works. Send the invite to both of us.

turns.speaker: Jordan (AE)
turns.text: Will do. I'll send the invite today with a one-page pilot outline and our security overview link.
